name: Barista
ability: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
wakes: The Barista never wakes; the player the Storyteller picks is woken each night (including the first) to learn the effect. Night order: no number on the townsquare scale used by these specs (townsquare gives every Traveller a placeholder 1, and Fabled none); the official app nightsheet places it very early, before the Townsfolk (first night 10 of 80, other nights 6 of 99).
interaction: Each night the Storyteller chooses a player and an effect. That player is shown THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU and the Barista token, then one finger (sober, healthy and true info) or two fingers (ability works twice).
drunk_or_poisoned: If the Barista is drunk or poisoned, the chosen effect does not apply.

rulings.text: A sober-and-healthy player loses drunkenness and poisoning, cannot be made drunk or poisoned until dusk, and gets true info even with a Vortox in play.
A player whose ability works twice acts at its normal time twice (wake, sleep, wake again); mandatory abilities must be used twice, optional ones may be.
A used once-per-game ability may be used again; an unused one may be used twice before dusk.
The Barista does not learn the choice; the affected player does.
Previous reminders are removed each night; effects last until dusk.

test_scenarios.name: sober and healthy through poison
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barista, Bob Empath, Carol Poisoner, Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Carol poisons Bob; the Storyteller gives Bob SOBER & HEALTHY.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is shown the Barista and one finger, is not poisoned, and gets a true Empath number.

test_scenarios.name: true info under Vortox
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barista, Bob Seamstress, Dave Vortox.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: the Storyteller makes Bob sober and healthy; Bob uses his ability.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob gets true info despite the Vortox.

test_scenarios.name: Witch acts twice
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barista, Bob Witch, Carol Monk, Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: the Storyteller gives Bob ABILITY TWICE.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob wakes, curses a player, sleeps, wakes again and curses a second player; both are cursed tomorrow.

test_scenarios.name: once-per-game reused
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barista, Bob Slayer (ability used), Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: the Storyteller gives Bob ABILITY TWICE.
test_scenarios.expected: Day 2 (before dusk): Bob may use his Slayer shot again.

test_scenarios.name: expires at dusk
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barista, Bob Empath, Carol Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Bob made sober and healthy. Night 3: Carol poisons Bob, Barista picks someone else.
